{{Quote|I lost a ''Kaloth'' battlecruiser and eight hundred good men to that Vader-ripped ''katchni''.|Zothip|<ref name="VOTF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>}}
'''"Katchni"''' was a [[List of phrases and slang/Legends|curse word]] once used by [[Zothip]], leader of the [[Cavrilhu Pirates]], in a conversation with [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Vilim Disra]].<ref name="VOTF" />
